All five axial parts on top
Same 17 parts · same 145 pads · 11.1% more area than active 100 × 90 mm
Blue dashed: full 30 mm USB service allowance. Grey dashed: narrow 5.5 mm header housing.
H2 antenna is internal: 15.325 mm to WIZ PCB, 15.56 mm laterally to the S3 board.
XIAO USB shell allowance: only 0.645 mm to H2 antenna and 0.680 mm to WIZ PCB.
No permanent USB cable in the H2 RF-clearance area. Lift the service cable vertically.
Study only: verify actual plug, vertical clearances, RF performance and enclosure before choosing this layout.
